#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

#define av_cold __attribute__((cold))
#define CONFIG_EXTRA 1
#define CONFIG_OPTIONAL_FEATURE 1

typedef struct FilterState {
    int width;
    int height;
} FilterState;

int prototype_decl_one(int x);
static void prototype_decl_two(int a, int b);

static const struct {
    int id;
    const char *name;
} codec_table[] = {
    { 1, "foo" },
    { 2, "bar" },
};

/* Comment with { and } in it */
// Line comment with { and }

static av_cold int init_context(FilterState *st)
{
    st->width = 1920;
    st->height = 1080;
    return 0;
}

static av_cold void uninit_context(FilterState *st)
{
    st->width = 0;
    st->height = 0;
}

static int multi_param(int a,
                       int b,
                       int c)
{
    return a + b + c;
}

static void nested_braces(int n)
{
    if (n > 0) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int tmp = i * 2;
            (void)tmp;
        }
    }
}

static int if_inside_body(int x)
{
#if CONFIG_EXTRA
    x += 1;
#else
    x += 2;
#endif
    return x;
}

#if CONFIG_OPTIONAL_FEATURE
static int optional_feature_calc(int val)
{
    return val * 3;
}
#endif

static int simple_helper(int a)
{
    return a * a;
}

static int clamp_val(int v, int min_val, int max_val)
{
    if (v < min_val)
        return min_val;
    if (v > max_val)
        return max_val;
    return v;
}

static int process_plane(uint8_t *dst, const uint8_t *src, int linesize, int w, int h)
{
    for (int y = 0; y < h; y++) {
        for (int x = 0; x < w; x++) {
            dst[x] = src[x];
        }
        dst += linesize;
        src += linesize;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int compute_sum(const int *data, int count)
{
    int s = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        s += data[i];
    }
    return s;
}

static int filter_frame(FilterState *st, int frame_num)
{
    int base = simple_helper(frame_num);
    return clamp_val(base, 0, st->width);
}

static av_cold int close_filter(FilterState *st)
{
    uninit_context(st);
    return 0;
}
